tools.name: net_whoami
tools.description: Look up the public IP address of the current connection (or a specific IP address if provided), along with its approximate location (city, region, country, coordinates, postal code), timezone, and network/ISP. Useful for answering questions like 'what is my IP address' or 'where am I connecting from'.

ip.description: Optional. A specific IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up instead of the current connection's address, e.g. '8.8.8.8'.
